description: Dept. of Local Government - North Central Province - Notify the Names of Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Chairman, Vice Chairman for Local Authorities in Administrative Districts of Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically announces the declaration of election results for local government authorities (Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Chairman, Vice Chairman) in accordance with Section 66 C (I) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains the names of elected officials for various Pradeshiya Sabhas and Urban Councils following local elections, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral results and declarations.
